# Question 1

Compute the average body mass of the Adelie penguins and report the value in a sentence. Keep your full answer inside the answer block below.

::: {#q1-answer .answer}
The average Adelie penguin in this data weighs about 3,701 grams, a little under 4 kilograms.

```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
mean(penguins$body_mass_g[penguins$species == "Adelie"], na.rm = TRUE)
```
:::

## Question 2

Adelie penguins turn out to be the lightest of the three species in the data, so it makes sense that this average sits well below the overall mean body mass.
